request.style: English, female solo voice, organ, cello, harp, strings, majestic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Long ago God spoke to fathers
In many ways through the prophets
But in these last days
He has spoken to us by his Son

[Pre-Chorus]
Whom he appointed heir of all things
And through whom he made the ages
Now the truth is clear

[Chorus]
The Son is the radiance of God's glory
The exact imprint of his being
Sustaining all things by his powerful word
Purification for sins complete

[Verse]
He sat down at the right hand
Of the Majesty on high
As much superior to angels
As the name he inherited surpasses theirs

[Chorus]
The Son is the radiance of God's glory
The exact imprint of his being
Sustaining all things by his powerful word
Purification for sins complete

[Bridge]
To which of the angels did God ever say
You are my Son today I have begotten you
I will be his Father and he will be my Son
Let all God's angels worship him

[Chorus]
The Son is the radiance of God's glory
The exact imprint of his being
Sustaining all things by his powerful word
Purification for sins complete

[Outro]
The radiance of God's glory
The exact imprint of his being
